messages:
maya: Heads-up — after onboarding the q6b-int4 transcode build we saw a duplicate surge in promptset ingest causing samplebank inflation, and the quant smoke showed a regression on long HTML/code-rich prompts. cc @aj @tony

aj: Can you paste the ingest query and a couple failure sample IDs?

maya: query: `SELECT id, text, hash(tokenize_v2(text)) FROM ingest WHERE source='web-scrape' ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC LIMIT 5000` ; example ids: 89f2, b3c1, a9d8 (I'll drop the full list in #eng-ml-files).

tony: Noted. My hunch is a tokenizer change (v1 -> v2) means near-duplicates bypass fuzzy dedupe. I can run a fuzzyhash sweep over the last 72h.

sophie: Label-ops note: label queue already +2.5k because duplicates re-entered. If we resample we should pause routing to annotators for ~30m so they don't see duplicate tasks. ops?

devin: We should add a small micro-golden of ~200 transcode-heavy prompts to the eval harness for quick regression detection. I'll draft a PR to add it and wire into the smoke run.

maya: Agreed. Also propose a temporary curation rule: collapse items when token-span similarity > 0.92. Tony can propose thresholds after the sweep.

tony: Running sweep now. Plan: fuzzyhash Jaccard on token spans + windowed overlap. Initial script: ```python
# fuzzycheck snippet
from tokenizer import v2
def sim(a,b):
    return jaccard(tokenize(a), tokenize(b))
```
I'll post full output in ~10m.

label_ops_bot: label-queue:paused by sophie for 00:45; 2,430 tasks moved to resample buffer.

aj: Quick quant smoke update: q6b-int4 shows +3% F1 drop on our HTML summarization benchmark. Failures concentrated on samples with repeated code blocks and weird escaping. Logs: https://redwood.internal/runs/1719901234

maya: Decision: pause the transcode build rollout to Dedicated for now. Action plan: (1) run dedupe sweep (owner: tony), (2) inject micro-golden into evals and re-run smoke (owner: devin), (3) resample and pause annotator routing until dedupe complete (owner: sophie). I'll open a checklist PR.

sophie: :thumbsup: coordinating annotator schedule now. ETA ~2h to clear resample backlog after pause.

devin: PR opened: github.com/redwood/evals/pull/412 — adds micro-golden transcode set + integration test. Smoke runs triggered.

tony: Sweep finished: collapsed 4,128 duplicates from the ingest window; suggested threshold after manual spot-check is 0.87 Jaccard (was 0.92). Posting patch to curation pipeline in 10m.

maya: Thanks everyone. Re-open rollout only after: green quant smoke (<=0.5% delta), pipeline patch merged, and label backlog under 500. Marking this thread as the triage record — follow-ups in linked PRs/threads.
